label: Generic clinical history
note: Runs for any complaint with no authored flow. Slot order is the order the engine prefers to fill them, but it always skips slots the patient has already answered.

slots.about: when it started and how long it has been going on
where in the body the problem is, if it has a location
what it feels like in their own words
how bad it is, out of ten, and whether it stops them doing things
whether it is getting better, worse, or staying the same
any other symptoms that came with it, such as fever, vomiting, or weight loss
whether it is worse at any particular time or in any position
what makes it better, and anything already tried

background.about: any ongoing or past medical conditions
whether they smoke now or used to, and roughly how much
whether they are or might be pregnant, if applicable
